summary: This is a routine earnings report on Form 6-K filed by Embotelladora Andina S.A. (Andina Bottling Co Inc) for the first quarter of 2026. It contains no transaction, no special-situation corporate action, and no binding agreement. The filing solely presents financial results, operational metrics, and commentary from the CEO regarding volume growth, digital transformation, and performance across geographic segments. As a standard periodic disclosure, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
